verdict.rationale: Relay offers in-platform high-yield savings accounts (up to 3.00% APY), and its auto-transfer rules sweep idle cash from operating accounts into savings, so funds never leave Relay. A community user separately confirms earning extra interest on money set aside for taxes. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of APY terms and conditions (the 'up to' rate and its footnote are unexplained), confirmation of whether operating/checking balances earn yield directly or only after a sweep, and stronger independent corroboration beyond one brief comment.
